case.title: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
case.briefing: Demo Gießerei GmbH, our single source for the grey-iron pump housing PH-100 for 12 years, announces +8.8 % from 1 December citing energy and wages. Castings are a strategic category: the goal is to stabilise supply with a healthy partner, so squeezing the foundry below a 4 % margin costs us (from EUR 5,000 per margin point and year). We need 4,000 housings a year for the next two years; anything not covered by this deal costs EUR 55.00 per unit (spot buys and a second source). Price, payment terms, contract length and the date the new price applies are open; lead time and Incoterm are fixed.

sup:DEMO-F1.subject: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
sup:DEMO-F1.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is always a pleasure to work with your esteemed house, continuing the strong tradition of craftsmanship and trust between our companies. For this agreement, our offer stands at a price of €52.90 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

To remain transparent about our situation, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. We take great pride in the dedication of our foundry workforce and the quality we deliver to our partners every day.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our successful cooperation together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
message.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Our offer stands at a price of €50.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027. This offer remains valid for 30 days. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. Please understand that our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

For many years, the close bond between Demo Gießerei GmbH and Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH has meant a great deal to us. We note your proposal to delay the effective date to April 2027, but we must maintain the December 2026 start to ensure immediate stability for both our houses. In exchange for keeping this earlier start date, we are prepared to lower our price to €50.30 per unit. This maintains the 30-day payment terms and 24-month contract length that we have both agreed upon.

Alternatively, with valid from 1 December 2026: €50.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

message.body:
Guten Tag,

We appreciate your continued interest and the slight adjustment in your proposal. We have worked together for many years, and I am confident this step brings us closer to a mutual agreement.

In response, we are prepared to reduce our price to €50.50 per unit, accepting your requested start date of 1 April 2027 alongside the 30-day payment terms and 24-month contract. To summarize our current proposal clearly, our offer consists of a price of €50.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Please note that this offer remains valid for 7 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
